name: Rosewood Phuket
insider_take: Rosewood Phuket isn't just another beachfront resort—it's an architectural marvel carved into the emerald hillsides of Emerald Bay, where infinity pools seem to spill directly into the Andaman Sea.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury resort features Thailand's first overwater pavilions on the west coast, plus the country's largest beachfront pool villa at 2,045 square meters. The property sits on a secluded 600-meter private beach and houses Phuket's only Asaya wellness concept—Rosewood's holistic approach combining ancient Eastern practices with modern wellness science.
pro_tip: Book the Oceanfront Pool Villa for unobstructed sunset views—the resort's clifftop location offers some of Phuket's most dramatic golden hour vistas without the crowds of popular sunset beaches.
dont_miss: The resort's signature dining at Red Sauce, helmed by renowned chef Mauro Colagreco, and the underground Chandelier Bar built into natural rock formations. Take the complimentary yacht to nearby Coral Island or explore the resort's private sea caves accessible only at low tide.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Emerald Bay
Ultra-luxurious pavilions and villas with private pools
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
World-class Asaya wellness sanctuary and spa
cons: Secluded location requires transportation for exploring
